trial_court: Senior Civil Judge Basavana Bagewadi (O.S. No.34/2006)
case_name: Mallappa S/O Channappa Malli And Anr vs Padmawwa W/O Revansiddappa Umanabadi

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mallappa S/O Channappa Malli, Neelamma W/O Channappa Malli
parties.respondent_defendant: Padmawwa W/O Revansiddappa Umanabadi, Yallappa S/O Revansiddappa Umanabadi, Laxmi Bai W/O Bhimappa Sitimani, Revansiddappa S/O Bhimappa Umanabadi

facts_of_case: Suit for partition and separate possession; plaintiffs filed an appeal in R.A.88/2010 against the judgment and decree passed by the trial court.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage between a minor and an adult is void.
legal_principles.held: The marriage of plaintiff No.1 with Revanasiddappa is void as she married during the minority.

legal_principles.principle: A person's marital status is determined by their actual conduct and not just by a void marriage.
legal_principles.held: Thereafter, Revanasiddapa was made to live with plaintiff No.1 at the instance of elders in the village and for all practical purposes, 1st plaintiff is the second wife

outcome.final_order: The First Appellate Court has declared that plaintiffs No.1 and 2 and defendants 1 and 4 are entitled to 1/4 share in suit item Nos.1 to 6 properties.
